privacy.ai_training_note: Generative AI features are powered by third-party LLMs but are NOT trained on Zendesk customer data; 'no third-party will use your inputs to train their models or otherwise improve their services' and 'these features are not trained on Zendesk customer data.' For LLMs hosted on Zendesk-controlled infrastructure (AWS Bedrock, Azure, GCP, Groq, Fireworks AI) the LLM provider never accesses Service Data and is not a sub-processor. Zendesk's own proprietary ML models are not generative; they may be trained on customer data ONLY to the extent the customer instructs (e.g. account-scoped intelligent triage/AI agent training within that customer's own instance), with data minimization and sanitization controls. Net: not trained on customer data by default; opt-in, account-scoped training only for the customer's own benefit.
privacy.data_region: Customer-selectable data locality: United States (US), Australia (AU), Japan (JP), or European Economic Area (EEA), per the Regional Data Hosting Policy. Hosted on AWS in US, Europe, and Asia Pacific.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: HTTPS/TLS 1.2 or higher over public networks; opportunistic TLS for email

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: AES-256 key encryption in AWS; BYOK available via Advanced Data Privacy and Protection add-on

security.name: Bug bounty / responsible disclosure
security.value: Responsible Disclosure / Bug Bounty Program via partnership with HackerOne

security.name: Penetration testing
security.value: Annual third-party penetration tests across Production and Corporate Networks, plus per-application pen tests on products

security.name: Authentication / access
security.value: SSO (SAML, OIDC), social SSO, 2FA (SMS or authenticator app), RBAC, IP restrictions, configurable password policies, MFA required for production access

security.name: Hosting & resilience
security.value: AWS data centers (ISO 27001 / PCI DSS L1 / SOC 2 certified), multi-AZ replication, Disaster Recovery program with optional contractual RTO/RPO via Enhanced DR

security.name: Data protection add-on
security.value: Advanced Data Privacy and Protection: BYOK encryption, custom data retention, data masking, PII redaction, access logs

security.name: Self-serve artifacts
security.value: Conveyor Trust Portal for on-demand certifications, audit reports, policies, and questionnaire answers

products.name: Zendesk AI Agents (customer service)
products.data_scope: Processes end-customer conversation/ticket Service Data; powered by third-party LLMs that do not train on customer data; account-scoped.
products.notes: Up to ~80% automation claim; learns within the customer's own account context only.

products.name: Zendesk Copilot
products.category: Agent-assist / generative AI for service teams
products.data_scope: Assists agents, admins, knowledge and analytics roles using account Service Data; LLM providers do not access or retain data when hosted on Zendesk-controlled infra.

products.name: Employee Service AI / internal service
products.data_scope: Permission-gated answers within the employee-service instance; same no-third-party-training posture.

products.name: Voice / Contact Center (agentic AI)
products.category: AI voice and omnichannel contact center
products.data_scope: Voice and digital channel Service Data; note SMS and some third-party integrations are encryption exceptions.

products.name: Advanced Data Privacy and Protection (add-on)
products.data_scope: Adds BYOK, custom retention, masking, PII redaction, access logs over base Service Data.
products.notes: Paid add-on for higher data-sensitivity tiers (e.g. HIPAA, regulated industries).

compare.pricing_model: Paid subscription, tiered plans (Suite/Support tiers from small business to Enterprise/Enterprise Plus) plus usage-based AI Agent automated resolutions; 14-day free trial. Add-ons (Advanced Data Privacy and Protection, Enhanced Disaster Recovery) priced separately.
compare.data_residency: Selectable: US, EEA, Australia, or Japan (Regional Data Hosting Policy); AWS-hosted

flags: Trust center evidence is geo-redirected (zendesk.de in EU); content is identical across regions, certificates downloadable from the canonical trust center.
SOC 2 Type II report and ISO certificates require NDA / request via Conveyor Trust Portal, not openly downloadable.

Zendesk's own proprietary (non-generative) ML models CAN be trained on a customer's data when the customer instructs it (account-scoped, opt-in) - this is normal and not cross-customer, but procurement should note the distinction.
Encryption exceptions exist for in-product SMS and customer-chosen third-party integrations.
